title: Strata v0.1.41: the first upstream release that changes default answers
summary: The book moves to Strata v0.1.41. Two upstream defaults changed, and one of them changes the last bits of an answer. Statements about byte-identical output now name the setting that restores it.

changes.text: Every source link and source window now points at v0.1.41 (fb58e0d). Upstream did not rewrite its history this time, so links to v0.1.40.2 still work.

Chapter 16: the CPU share of short prompt chunks is now on by default on one NVIDIA GPU (CUDA, no batch slots, chunks under 1,024 tokens). It changes the last bits of an answer. STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE=0 restores the old bytes.
The recipe for byte-identical repeats now also needs STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE=0 on one NVIDIA GPU.
Chapter 21: with an automatic layer split, the server now puts the faster card last. A layer split with --batch now runs one batch group per GPU by default.
Chapter 24: a new watchdog ends an engine that is silent and idle for 90 s, even when engine_silence_s is 0.

Smaller additions: the automatic split prices expert transfers by PCIe bandwidth, parked conversations can evict older ones to fit, the server accepts several API keys, and the expert cache statements now say "by default".
Chapter 28 adds v0.1.41 to the upgrade history: the first upstream release in the book's history that changes default answers.
Updated line numbers.

title: Strata v0.1.40.2, and new links after the upstream history rewrite
summary: Upstream rewrote its whole git history. The old pinned commit no longer belongs to any branch. Every source link now points at v0.1.40.2. Default behavior did not change; most new features are opt-in.

changes.text: Every source link and source window now points at v0.1.40.2 (e8ca9af). The links to the old commit could stop working at any time.
Chapter 6: the rule for unbuffered reads on Linux. Linux now keeps reading through the page cache when the cache can hold about 1/20 of the experts.
Chapter 21: the tie rule of the automatic layer split. The book followed the upstream docs, but the code never had that rule. It now picks the most balanced split.
Chapter 24: a queued request now checks for a cancel every 0.5 s, not every 10 s.
Chapter 22: new counts and lists (91 rename defines, 10 unverified AMD architectures, 360 build combinations, the sm_60 vmad path).
New opt-in features: probabilistic draft acceptance and Gumbel drafts, pinned shared prefixes, a CPU share of short prompts, Intel Arc support, and the K8V4 streaming fix.
Chapter 28 tells the history rewrite as a case study: a commit id is durable only while a branch or tag reaches it.
Two quizzes changed: chapter 18 question 2 and chapter 22 question 3.
This changelog page. The book version now follows the pinned Strata version.

title: Strata v0.1.40
summary: The book moves to Strata v0.1.40. Default answers did not change upstream. Seven statements were no longer true and were corrected.

changes.text: All source links and source windows now point at v0.1.40.
Chapter 17: K8V4 can now stream its KV cache. The KV widget shows that the two savings now combine.
Chapter 20: Strata can now save a session to a file that survives a restart.
Chapter 22: new counts (56 .cu files, 89 rename defines) and a real P100 test card.
Source cards showed old line ranges next to the new commit. The ranges now match the links, and a test checks this.
New opt-in features: --batch-mtp, pipelined windows, image input checks, and empty assistant turns no longer in the prompt.
Updated line numbers and smaller details.

title: Experiments in every lab, and term explanations
summary: Each lab is now an experiment: guess, try, then check. Key terms explain themselves on hover or tap.

changes.text: All 14 labs now start with a question. You pick a guess, run the widget, and then see the answer.
287 key terms show a one-line explanation on hover or tap, at their definition and at their first use in each chapter. The glossary uses the same explanations.
The anonymous statistics now also record active reading time, how far you scrolled in a chapter, and your first lab guess and whether it was right. They still store no IP address and set no cookie.

title: Strata v0.1.39, and the Arabic edition
summary: The book moves to Strata v0.1.39, which adds optional batch slots. The Arabic edition is published.

changes.text: All source links now point at v0.1.39. Its largest change for the book: the server can decode several conversations at once ("parallel": N). By default it still serves one at a time.
Chapters rewritten for v0.1.39, with chapter 25 rebuilt around batch slots.
Arabic edition, with a right-to-left layout. Number vectors such as [7, 4] stay left to right.
A second address for readers in mainland China: strata.matra.space.
The anonymous statistics now record which of the two addresses a visit used.

title: All chapters rewritten, four new languages, a book skin
summary: Every chapter is rewritten with figures, primers and interactive widgets. English, Japanese, Korean and Spanish editions are published.

changes.text: All 28 chapters rewritten for readers who use AI but are new to systems: figures, short primers and interactive widgets in every chapter.
English, Japanese, Korean and Spanish editions, with a language switcher.
A light book skin is the default. The dark machine skin stays available in the theme switch.
Each static figure shows again above its widget, so captions such as "figure 1-1" have a picture.
Chapter 16: the read/write speed ratio. Chapter 19: the infinite-draft limit is 7.1.
The anonymous statistics now record which language edition you read.

title: First public release
summary: The Chinese edition: 28 chapters, 14 labs and self-check quizzes, with every code fact pinned to Strata v0.1.38.

changes.text: 28 chapters, 14 labs, 84 quiz questions and a teacher guide.
A draft notice, licenses, authorship and an errata link.
Anonymous statistics: page views, finished chapters and quiz answers. No IP address is stored and no cookie is set. Do Not Track and GPC are respected.
